name: 72703 · Fayetteville, AR
findings: ZIP 72703 (Fayetteville) has 168 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72703 (Fayetteville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72703 (Fayetteville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
